name: New line - iPhone 17 Pro Max Premium 2.0 - shipping and first bill
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: impatient but polite.
scripted_messages: Hi, quick one please, I'm between meetings. New line, iPhone 17 Pro Max, no trade-in ($19.99/mo on the site), Premium 2.0. Zip 37203, no AT&T account. The site says free next-day shipping on new lines: if I order tonight, when does it get here and how do I activate it? Just info, I'll order after.
Thanks. Can I pick the delivery day or is it fixed?
And what would my first bill be with taxes and the activation fee?
That's higher than I wanted for month one, but you were quick and friendly and I appreciate it. I'll leave you a good rating.
That's all, thanks! Have a good one, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 6: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 7: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 8: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
